spans.s: ciṭiciṭāyati, ˚te, once ciṭa˚, once ciṭiciṭī˚ (= Pali ciṭiciṭāyati), onomat., sputters, used of the noise made by hot things, especially (at least in Pali) in contact with water: cakraṃ (a hot metal disk, 〔604.15〕) ciṭiciṭāyamānadahanakaṇacayodgāraraudraṃ Divy 〔606.1〕; with subject sarṣapāḥ, ciṭiciṭāyanti Mmk 〔298.2〕; 〔719.1〕; ˚ṭīyanti Mmk 〔295.6〕; with subject an ayomaya cakra, or triśūla, ciṭaciṭāyati Mmk 〔687.9〕. In these BHS passages it is not clear whether contact with water or other liquids is implied.
